data.text: For agent-interface-design integration: photo-informed 3D twin is self-contained in OfficeTwin.tsx, officeScene.ts, office-twin.css. Root keeps styles.css unchanged and adds only App import, view state/nav, scenario callback, and OfficeTwin props/render. Existing App request logic and approval fingerprints remain. Merge by retaining OfficeTwin placement above request queue or as separate tab in new layout; twin styles use explicit local colors so independent of light/dark base. Three.js is the only rendering dependency.
